BL-677 — Epic backfill over backlog/done/, slice 2 — apply the human-approved mapping in batched commit-integrity commits, idempotent, never overwriting
Approval context: Slice 2 of the done-epic-backfill (see BL-676). Decisions to sign off: (1) the apply refuses to run unless the mapping file carries an explicit human approval line — the report BL-676 emits is inert until a human stamps it; (2) writes land as BATCHED commits through the shared commit-integrity path…
BL-677 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-677" (or "reject BL-677 <reason>") to act.
